title: N-AALP Channel and Object-Kind Registry
description: Schema for the JSON representation of vectors/registry/channels.csv: an array of row objects, one per (channel, object-kind) pair. The CI check converts the CSV to this array (header row -> object keys) and coerces kind_code to int before validating. channel_id is a 16-bit hex code point (the twenty channels 0x0000-0x0013); kind_code is the per-channel kind index; effect is the authorization effect class (ADR-0004); variable_effect is the string 'true' exactly for the variable-effect kinds and 'false' otherwise, an invariant enforced by the if/then/else below. Format/required/enum defects and any effect<->variable_effect inconsistency are caught here; the (channel_id, kind_code) composite-key DUPLICATE check (which JSON Schema cannot express) is done by the companion scripts/validate_registries.py.

channel_id.description: 16-bit channel identifier, hex-prefixed, exactly 4 hex digits (e.g. 0x0000).

channel_name.description: Channel name; MUST be non-empty (e.g. Control).

kind_name.description: Object-kind name; MUST be non-empty (e.g. Hello).

effect.description: The authorization effect class of the kind (ADR-0004: effect is authorization).

variable_effect.description: String boolean: 'true' iff the kind's effect is determined per-object at runtime (effect=variable).
